g.text: implements one feature · writes tests · commits
verifies vs spec · adversarial probes · eval JSON
ADR promote · CONTEXT merge · codemap regen
· vertical slice — features cross every layer (no horizontal phases; plan_lint L10a)
· PASS / FAIL only — no WARN, no STRICT, no PASS_WITH_TODO
· no deferred punt — open_questions resolve in-batch (feature_local · architectural · glossary)
· bounded loop — max 3 rounds per feature; round-3 FAIL → status: deferred
· lint is the contract — fix the source design when checks fight you
· codebase as SSoT — alive docs (CONTEXT.md · ADRs · CODEMAP) supplement only
· skill-shaped agents — no agent code outside skills; prompts inline their constraints
